acceptanceCriteria: Both public and N-1 release acceptance harnesses register EXIT cleanup before failure-prone setup and leave no temporary run_root on success or failure.
Source checkout isolation manifests detect tracked and untracked .ai mutations while excluding only declared output artifacts.
Isolation manifests capture file, directory, and symlink metadata and reject symlink targets escaping TMPDIR or CARGO_HOME.
Existing success, failure, cleanup-failure, and public no-source-fallback regressions remain passing.
Three release-language documents describe the actually verified v0.2.23 aarch64-apple-darwin acceptance target without changing published Release truth.
goal: Make post-release adopter and N-1 acceptance cleanup and isolation proofs fail-closed and auditable without changing Runtime Core or published Release truth.
intent: Repair temporary-root cleanup registration, source checkout manifests, symlink containment, regression wrappers, and three-language release documentation so failure paths cannot leak or silently mutate the governed repository.
outOfScope: published Release tags and historical evidence
